snip.t: Scrotal edema may occur in nephrotic syndrome as well, and orchitis is an occasional finding in HSP.
This is a very common childhood infection (when vaccinations are not done) resulting in orchitis as well as parotitis.
In older men, epididymo-orchitis is typically due to urinary tract pathogens (enteric gram-negative bacilli like E. coli) rather than STIs (which are more typical in younger, sexually active men).

snip.t: | Pain | Loin pain (renal colic: loin-to-groin, colicky, with restlessness; renal capsule distension: dull ache), suprapubic pain (cystitis, retention), perineal pain (prostatitis), testicular pain (torsion, epididymo-orchitis), and penile pain |
snip.s: Urology: History, Examination and Common Presenting Symptoms

snip.t: | Infective | Urinary tract infection (cystitis, pyelonephritis), prostatitis, urethritis, epididymo-orchitis, tuberculosis, schistosomiasis (terminal haematuria in a child or young adult in an endemic area, from bladder wall eggs) |
Excessive production of fluid: secondary hydrocele (infection such as epididymo-orchitis, torsion, trauma, tumour, after surgery or radiotherapy).
| Epididymitis / epididymo-orchitis | Sexually active men (chlamydia, gonorrhoea) or older men and children (urinary tract infection, *E. coli*).

snip.t: Complications of orchidopexy: testicular atrophy (about 5%, from devascularisation), recurrence or high position of the testis, injury to the vas deferens (1 to 2%), wound haematoma and scrotal swelling, epididymo-orchitis, hydrocele and later hernia.

qs.q: A 30-year-old man is evaluated for infertility and a history of childhood mumps infection complicated by orchitis. Which microscopic change is most characteristic of the severe sequelae of mumps orchitis in adults?
o: Presence of intratubular germ cell neoplasia
Presence of tubular atrophy and fibrosis
qs.e: Mumps orchitis involves a lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate that can lead to severe necrosis, tubular atrophy, fibrosis, and subsequent sterility. Caseous granulomatous inflammation is characteristic of tuberculous epididymo-orchitis.
